name: duplicate_invoice_check
description: Detects potential duplicate supplier invoices using fuzzy matching and AI classification. Compares invoices in a user-defined received-date window against historical invoices from the same supplier across four criteria: invoice reference similarity, invoice date proximity, invoice amount match, and PO/date match. Classifies flagged pairs as LIKELY_DUPLICATE, LIKELY_ADJUSTMENT, LIKELY_RECURRING, or UNCERTAIN. Produces an executive summary and Excel report. Triggers: duplicate invoice, duplicate check, duplicate detection, overpayment risk, double payment, AP duplicate, check for duplicates, invoice fraud, identify duplicates.
